analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, moving from 56.8 to 61.6 and then to 58.9. MACD histogram improvement remains unconfirmed. The current price of $1.42 is above the SMA20 at $1.39 but faces resistance near the Bollinger Band middle line at $1.39. Volume ratio at 2.10 (surge) compared to the 5-day average, but lacks directional conviction.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price($1.42) vs SMA5/20/50($1.36/$1.39/$1.28): Above short-term SMA20, mid-term SMA50, and long-term SMA200, indicating a bullish position.
· Position relative to SMA100($1.17)/SMA200($1.27): Confirmed strength in the medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (20.2%) + Current price level is elevated from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (57.6→58.9) + Neutral zone consolidation + Weakening upward momentum diagnosed.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0111→-0.0137) + Holding steady diagnosed + Trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Line $1.39) + Bandwidth at 9.89% interpreted as normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1.38) + Based on SMA20 and Pivot S1.
· Swing Resistance ($1.46) + Breakout faces Bollinger upper band resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Sideways pattern diagnosed with lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.10x) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Accumulation phase + Observation conditions specified.
